propositions: AcliClient caches JQL search results indefinitely per client instance, including negative (empty) answers, with no TTL or invalidation mechanism
Callers working around stale cache results reach into private _search_cache dict directly (access_check.py, _fresh_search), violating encapsulation
Client lifetime is one reconcile pass per instance; fresh_backend is constructed on each pass, making cross-pass cache replay impossible but requiring per-pass invalidation support
Existing negative cache entries prevent queries re-issued on the same client instance from reaching Jira, causing d30c bug where index-visibility polling gets stale answers
AcliClient needs a public invalidate_search_cache(jql=None) method to evict memo entries and document the negative-caching hazard in search_issues docstring
